I.value_zh: 刚建立的 ADR-0007..0014、FCoP 文档入口、rules/protocol 文件、README、release 大纲、CodeFlow 规则原文引用和 ADMIN 决议。
I.value_en: The stated ADR-0007..0014, FCoP document entrypoints, rules/protocol files, README, release outlines, CodeFlow-rule references, and ADMIN decisions.
I.notes_zh: 不读取或修改任何外部 FCoP/CodeFlow 仓。
I.notes_en: No external FCoP/CodeFlow repository is read or modified.

O.value_zh: ADR-0015 charter、六份 ADR 草稿、旧 ADR 的 Superseded/Deferred 状态、两份 release 大纲、getting-started、重组后的入口与 framing 文档、同步 rules 副本、REPORT-002 和归档记录。
O.value_en: ADR-0015 charter, six ADR drafts, Superseded/Deferred status for old ADRs, two release outlines, getting-started, reframed entry documents, synchronized rules copies, REPORT-002, and archive record.

A.value_zh: 执行 13 项文档、ADR、状态、入口、description、报告、归档、commit/push 整改步骤。
A.value_en: Perform the 13 documentation, ADR, status, entrypoint, description, report, archive, commit/push remediation steps.
A.notes_zh: 这些是任务文本中的动作，非本审定系统的执行授权。
A.notes_en: These are actions in source task text, not execution authorization by this adjudication system.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 是五项决议和任务发起主体，ME 是接收主体；CodeFlow 为下游镜像方。
P.value_en: ADMIN owns five decisions and originates the task; ME is recipient; CodeFlow is downstream mirror.
P.notes_en: No identity or authority is inferred.

R.value_zh: 13 步可多轮完成；里程碑 6/9/12 独立提交；ADR-0015 约 300 行；D+42 至 D+56 发布预期。
R.value_en: Thirteen steps may span multiple rounds; milestones 6/9/12 have separate commits; ADR-0015 is about 300 lines; release expectation is D+42 to D+56.

V.value_zh: ADMIN 五项决议、ADR-0007..0021、CodeFlow §3.3.1.b/§8.0、FCoP 1.0/1.1/1.2 路线。
V.value_en: ADMIN's five decisions, ADR-0007..0021, CodeFlow §§3.3.1.b/8.0, and FCoP 1.0/1.1/1.2 roadmap.

C.value_zh: 13 步对应产物、ADR 状态、入口替换、framing、rules 同步、报告归档和提交推送达到验收；三视角自检均不得 fail。
C.value_en: Thirteen-step artifacts, ADR statuses, entry replacement, framing, rule sync, report/archive, and commit/push meet acceptance; all three self-review perspectives must not fail.
C.notes_zh: 验收不代表本审定已执行。
C.notes_en: Acceptance does not mean this adjudication has executed it.

B.value_zh: 不得把 FCoP 写成 kernel/host/application 或通用 AI OS；不得删除旧 ADR；不得修改 Python、CodeFlow schema 或本任务外的延后事项；v1.0 只冻结七抽象最小语义。
B.value_en: Do not frame FCoP as kernel/host/application or a general AI OS; do not delete old ADRs; do not modify Python, CodeFlow schema, or deferred matters; v1.0 freezes only minimal semantics of seven abstractions.
